title: Minkowski spacetime in rescaled inertial coordinates

coordinate_system.name: Linearly rescaled inertial coordinates
coordinate_system.description: A four-dimensional chart related to the canonical Cartesian chart by t = 2 tau, x = 3 xi, y = 4 eta, and z = 5 zeta.

assumptions: The declared Jacobian is constant, exact, invertible, and maps the submitted chart to the canonical Cartesian Minkowski chart.
The submitted metric is the exact pullback J^T diag(-1, 1, 1, 1) J.
The cosmological constant is zero for this benchmark profile.
This is a coordinate-equivalence and reproducibility benchmark, not a transportation proposal or a new spacetime.

claims.statement: The submitted metric is exactly the canonical Minkowski metric expressed in the declared rescaled inertial coordinates.

falsification: Reject the benchmark if the coordinate lists, metric, or Jacobian are not four-dimensional and mutually consistent.
Reject coordinate equivalence if the Jacobian is singular or J^T diag(-1, 1, 1, 1) J does not exactly equal the submitted metric.
Reject the flatness implication if any submitted component or Jacobian entry is not a supported exact numeric constant.
Downgrade reproducibility if the separate implementation path does not recover the same check outcomes.
